goals: Verify the FAQ page's category filtering functionality.
Verify the FAQ page's search functionality with various inputs.
activities: For each category in "Isoman", "Kontak Erat", "PCR", "Pasca Isoman", "Tanda Bahaya", "Tatalaksana Isoman", "Terapi", "Umum", "Vaksinasi":
Navigate to the "/faq" page.
Wait for the "Kategori Pertanyaan" combobox to be visible.
Select the current category name from the "Kategori Pertanyaan" combobox.
Assert that the page URL contains the category's URL parameter.
Assert that a badge with the current category name is visible.
Navigate to the "/faq" page.
Fill the search textbox with "Isoman".
Press "Enter" in the search textbox.
Assert that text containing "isoman" is visible.
Assert that the page URL contains "/faq?q=Isoman".
Navigate to the "/faq" page.
Fill the search textbox with "Dok apakah saya bisa tertular lagi setelah selesai isoman?".
Press "Enter" in the search textbox.
Assert that the text "YA. Anda masih bisa tertular apabila tidak menerapkan 5M" is visible.
Navigate to the "/faq" page.
Fill the search textbox with "qwerty".
Press "Enter" in the search textbox.
Assert that the text "Pertanyaan tidak ditemukan" is visible.
Assert that the page URL contains "/faq?q=qwerty".
